chunks: ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḙā Al-‘Aťťār, from someone who was from Ray, who said:

I went to Abi al-Ḥasan al-‘Askari (peace be upon him) and he asked me, “Where were you?” I replied, “I went to the Ziyārah of al-Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (peace be upon him).” He said, “Indeed, if you had gone to the Ziyārah of the grave of ‘Abd al-‘Ażīm near you, you would have been like those who have gone to the Ziyārah of al-Ḥusain (peace be upon him).”
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual merit of visiting the grave of ‘Abd al-‘Ażīm compared to visiting Imam al-Ḥusain?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Hasan al-Askari (peace be upon him) equates the spiritual merit of visiting ‘Abd al-‘Ażīm ibn ‘Abdillāh in Ray with that of visiting Imam al-Ḥusain (peace be upon him), highlighting the elevated status of the Sayyids of the Prophet’s family. This comparison underscores the concept of *wilayah* and the intercessory value of the Ahl al-Bayt’s descendants, reinforcing the practice of *ziyarat* as a means of drawing closer to divine grace through the progeny of the Imams.
